title: Fernhill Annual Report 2026
summary: This report covers Fernhill Outdoor Co.’s financial and operating performance for 2026, including financial results, segment performance, sustainability progress, key risks, and plans for 2027. It can answer questions about year-over-year revenue, margins, income and cash flow; sales by product segment and channel; recycled materials, emissions, and repair and resale; supply-chain, weather, and currency risks; and the company’s 2027 outlook, investments, and expansion plans. The report includes comparison and segment-revenue tables, plus a chart of quarterly revenue by segment.

title: Fernhill Employee Handbook
summary: This handbook outlines Fernhill’s working arrangements and employee policies across offices, stores, and distribution centres, noting that contracts and local law take precedence. It covers working hours and location, time off, pay and benefits, expenses and travel, equipment and security, and conduct—including approval processes, eligibility rules, reporting deadlines, and ways to raise concerns. Tables summarize additional leave types and travel meal allowances; the handbook was last updated in January 2026.
